Hi Amy,

Thanks again for running the POC with us last month — really appreciate the team's partnership. I promised a short, consumable recap of the outcomes; attaching a one-page summary and the latency charts for quick context. High level from the 3-week pilot (mixed production-like traffic):

- Median end-to-end response latency down ~60% (from ~420ms -> ~170ms) for the 4096 token config
- Per-inference cost reduced ~45% after applying Redwood Optimize batching + KV caching
- Sustained throughput increased ~3x under concurrent sessions compared to your baseline
- Error/retry rate fell from 2.1% -> 0.3% after fallback tuning

Would ClearView be comfortable with a very short public blurb (1–2 lines) and permission to mention these metrics in a customer case note? If it's easier, we'd love a 10-minute call to capture a 1–2 sentence quote from you or a named ops contact. We can anonymize any details if you prefer (e.g., remove product names, round numbers).

Suggested times (PST): Wed 27 Jul 10:00–10:15, Thu 28 Jul 11:30–11:45, Fri 29 Jul 09:00–09:15. If none of these work, happy to match what fits your calendar.

Attachments: [Attachment: ClearView_POC_summary.pdf (18KB)], [Attachment: latency_charts.png (120KB)]

Thanks — short and no pressure, just hoping to capture a quick line for our case roll-up.
